name: Drowned Choir
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The drowned choir makes three attacks, using Choir or Drowned Refrain. It can replace one attack with a use of Cold Requiem.

actions.name: Choir
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) cold damage.

actions.name: Drowned Refrain
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) cold damage.

actions.name: Cold Requiem
actions.description: One creature within 60 feet must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) cold damage on a failed save. On a failed save, the target is also deafened until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The drowned choir casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15): - **At will:** *Fog Cloud*
**1/day each:** *Blindness/Deafness*, *Slow*, *Bestow Curse*

actions.name: Binding Chord
actions.description: One creature within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the end of its next turn.

generation.userConcept: a drowned cathedral choir that sings in one voice
generation.cite: composition after Spirit Naga (CR 8) — the or-form bite-and-ray with the debuff single
